title: Grandpa's house in town
body:
Read the extract and answer the question.
"Grandpa hated the noise and bustle of city life and when they were on their own, he often spoke, longingly, of his small brick house in town. 'Such a wonderful place...! With that big mango tree in the garden! It is so quiet that at dusk you can even hear a leaf fall!' But then Grandpa had slipped and fallen in the garden late one evening while he was pottering around and lain outside all night because there was no one at home to help him up." (Vitamin-M, Asha Nehemiah)

title: Grandpa's reply in the evening
body:
Read the extract and answer the question.
"'I had a quiet morning, but I don't know about Ravi. He just disappeared instead of staying at home to look after me like you told him to,' answered Grandpa coolly, while Ravi just looked confused and embarrassed. Grandpa had another surprise for Ravi. A gift-wrapped parcel! 'But, Papa, Ravi's birthday was three months ago. Have you forgotten?' exclaimed Ravi's mother, impatiently." (Vitamin-M, Asha Nehemiah)

title: The last stanza of the poem
body:
Read the extract and answer the question.
"I cannot remember my mother
only when from my bedroom window I send
my eyes into the blue of the distant sky,
I feel that the stillness of
my mother's gaze on my face
has spread all over the sky." (I Cannot Remember My Mother, Rabindranath Tagore)
